CustomField.description: Calculates the person’s age based on date of birth.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(PersonContact.Birthdate), NULL, YEAR(TODAY()) - YEAR(PersonContact.Birthdate) - IF( OR( MONTH(TODAY()) < MONTH(PersonContact.Birthdate), AND( MONTH(TODAY()) = MONTH(PersonContact.Birthdate), DAY(TODAY()) < DAY(PersonContact.Birthdate) ) ), 1, 0 ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Calculates the person’s age based on date of birth.
CustomField.label: Age
